title: Seal one-time pairing messages
responsibility: Derive separate pairing request and approval keys and encrypt or decrypt their JSON payloads.

inputs.name: pairingEnvelope.context
inputs.description: Host and pairing IDs, phone ephemeral public key, host public key and their ECDH secret.

inputs.name: sealPairing.key
inputs.description: Single-use AES-GCM key derived for the specified message kind.

inputs.name: openPairing.key
inputs.description: Matching AES-GCM key for this message purpose.

inputs.name: openPairing.sealed
inputs.description: Unpadded base64url ciphertext and authentication tag.

outputs.name: pairingEnvelope
outputs.description: Separate nonextractable AES keys for request and approval, bound to the pairing identities and public keys.

outputs.name: sealPairing
outputs.description: Base64url authenticated ciphertext of the JSON value using a zero nonce and purpose-specific associated data.

outputs.name: openPairing
outputs.description: Parsed JSON payload after authentication and strict UTF-8 decoding.
